description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view 'SystemRunSettingsView' along with its related view components and a view model 'ExecApprovalsSettingsModel'. It manages system run settings related to execution approvals, agent selection, security policies, allowlist management, and UI interactions for a macOS application.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: A view model class managing the state and logic for execution approval settings, including agent selection, security configurations, allowlist management, and synchronization with persistent storage.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistEntry
classes.description: Data model representing an allowlist entry with pattern, last used timestamp, command, and resolved path info.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsTab
classes.description: An enum defining the different tabs ('policy' and 'allowlist') in the UI for organizing settings.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Loads agent data, settings, and skill bins asynchronously.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Fetches the list of agents from persistent storage and updates internal state, ensuring a default agent if necessary.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Selects a specific agent by ID, loads its settings, and refreshes skill bins.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads security, ask, fallback settings, and allowlist entries for a specific agent.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates the security policy for the current agent or defaults.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-allow for skill CLIs and refreshes skill bins accordingly.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern after validating it, updating persistent store, and returning validation reason if invalid.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist entry after validation and syncs with storage.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an allowlist entry and updates storage.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves an allowlist entry by UUID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Fetches current skill bins, optionally forcing a refresh.

methods.name: syncQuickMode
methods.description: Synchronizes UI quick mode based on current security and ask settings.
